verifiedFacts.fact: Trainer Matthew Smith is weather-watching before choosing between the Group 3 Bart Cummings at Flemington and Group 2 Metropolitan at Randwick on 3 Oct. Flemington was Good 3 on Thursday morning; Smith explicitly said he did not want a heavy track. Aethelwulf remained in both fields at the source time.

Trainer Grahame Begg confirmed the mare will run in the Group 1 Turnbull Stakes at Flemington on 3 Oct despite the wet-weather risk. Her latest run was fifth in the Makybe Diva Stakes on 12 Sep; the Caulfield Cup on 17 Oct remains the stated focus.
